jobs.title: Program Coordinator, Experienced
jobs.description:
**Your Role**

The Medi-Cal Quality Improvement team is responsible for improving preventive care outcomes and increasing member access to quality healthcare services throughout Los Angeles County. The Program Coordinator, Experienced Quality Improvement (HEDIS) will report to the Senior Manager, Medi-Cal Quality Improvement and play a key role in supporting the planning, coordination, and execution of mobile Well Child and Mammogram Clinics at Community Resource Centers (CRCs), provider sites, and community-based locations.

In this role, you will coordinate day-to-day operations related to clinic implementation, scheduling logistics, and performance tracking to help improve preventive care measures, including Well Child Visits, and Breast Cancer Screening.

**This role requires this person to live within 50 miles of the Long Beach office.**

**This is a hybrid field worker role, where this person will be visiting clinics about 75% of the time.**

  

**Your Work**

In this role, you will:

* Coordinate the execution of mobile Well Child and Mammogram Clinics across Community Resource Centers and partner locations throughout Los Angeles County.
* Collaborate with Mobile Clinic Program Manager to ensure clinic readiness and successful event execution.
* Monitor clinic performance metrics, attendance reports, screening completion rates, and HEDIS-related outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Maintain project trackers, clinic dashboards, and databases to support operational and quality improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate meeting logistics, calendars, agendas, and communications for clinic planning and quality improvement activities.
* Assist Quality Improvement Program Managers with implementing strategies designed to improve access to preventive services and achieve departmental and organizational goals.
* Identify and resolve operational barriers related to site location, equipment needs, staffing coordination, and member engagement.
* Collaborate in cross-functional planning efforts with Clinic Program Manager to align mobile clinic operations with Medi-Cal Quality Improvement objectives and community health priorities.
* Manage multiple clinic initiatives simultaneously while maintaining a high level of accuracy, attention to detail, and customer service.
* Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders and synthesize information from multiple sources to support informed decision-making and successful program implementation.
* Manage support tasks such as monitoring the provider services email box, provider fax blasts, member incentive reconciliation, care gap report quality assurance review, etc.

  

**Your Knowledge and Experience**

* Requires a Bachelor’s degree or High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree
* Requires 3 years of prior relevant experience
* This person is required to live within 50 miles of the Long Beach office
* Basic understanding of HEDIS Quality measures preferred
* Member and/or community facing experience preferred
* Bilingual (Spanish) preferred
* Requires a solid understanding of project and resource management, strong business acumen, and team focus.
* Intermediate skill in MS Office products (including Outlook, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, Word)
* Beginner level proficiency in the management of small to medium internal databases, including demonstrated ability to create and manipulate spreadsheets and databases, as well as using graphic software to display results

**Hybrid – Field Worker**

This role requires employees to be in-office based on our hybrid workplace model, balancing purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility. For most teams, this means coming into the office two days each week.

We are requiring this person to live within 50 miles of the Long Beach office.

Ascendiun is a nonprofit corporate entity that is the parent to a family of organizations including Blue Shield of California and its subsidiary, Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan; Altais, a clinical services company; and Stellarus, a company designed to scale healthcare solutions. Together, these organizations are referred to as the Ascendiun Family of Companies.

To achieve our mission, we foster an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute fully to address the needs of the various communities we serve. We are committed to creating and maintaining a supportive workplace that upholds our values and advances our goals.

jobs.title: Program Specialist I, II, III
jobs.description:
**Job Title(s):** Part-Time Program Specialist I, II, III

**Reports to:** Operations Department

**Wages:** $19.00 - $26.00 Hourly \*Actual wages are based upon level of education and or experience\*

**Position Summary:**

The Part-Time **Program Specialist I, II, III** provides individualized support to individuals with intellectual and developmental disabilities through one-on-one coaching, skill development, educational support, employment preparation, independent living, and community-based activities. The Program Specialist helps individuals work toward their personal goals while providing support across a variety of settings and maintaining accurate documentation of support, progress, and services.

Some key responsibilities of this role are providing direct educational support, including assistance with school participation, academic activities, organization, communication, assignments, and educational routines; promoting independent living skills; and supporting with Community Integration and Employment Goals. The Program Specialist adapts instruction and support to fit each individual's needs and learning style while promoting independence.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Facilitate virtual check-ins and video sessions with individuals and families to assess progress, review personal goals, and determine support needs.**

You will lead regular individual and family video sessions to build rapport, monitor progress, review goals, and identify changing support needs using trauma-informed, person-centered communication. Bilingual English/Spanish communication will support clear and culturally responsive engagement.

* **Provide direct individualized educational support to individuals.**

You will provide one-on-one educational support based on each individual's needs, abilities, learning style, and goals, including school routines, classroom participation, assignments, organization, and time management. Support should encourage participation while promoting independence.

* **Support individuals in developing academic and educational skills.**

You will help individuals develop communication, organization, task completion, problem-solving, self-advocacy, study habits, and other skills that support educational success. Instruction will be adapted to each individual's learning style and support needs.

* **Plan and lead individualized coaching sessions focused on employment readiness, independent living, educational success, and personal development.**

You will provide structured, goal-driven coaching based on each individual's strengths, needs, and goals, including areas such as interview preparation, budgeting, communication, organization, educational participation, and daily living. Coaching should be adapted to the individual's learning style while tracking progress and outcomes.

* **Utilize individualized teaching and instructional techniques to support learning and skill development.**

You will use appropriate strategies such as modeling, prompting, repetition, reinforcement, and step-by-step instruction to help individuals learn and practice new skills while gradually increasing independence.

* **Support individuals with educational routines, schedules, and responsibilities.**

You will assist individuals with following educational schedules, transitioning between activities, preparing materials, completing assignments, managing time, and maintaining routines that promote greater independence.

* **Conduct virtual work readiness training, including mock interviews, resume workshops, and job search support.**

You will provide training in resume development, interview preparation, digital literacy, and online job searches, with opportunities for one-on-one coaching and support as needed.

* **Provide individualized instruction and skill training across educational, community, employment, and daily living environments.**

You will help individuals develop and apply skills across educational, community, employment, and daily living settings, including hygiene, cooking, laundry, mobility, community navigation, social skills, and employment-related skills.

* **Design and implement engaging remote community-based activities, and support transitions to in-person programming when needed.**

You will create and facilitate accessible virtual activities that encourage social connection, engagement, and community participation, while providing continuity and support when individuals transition to in-person programming.

* **Collaborate with on-site staff, job coaches, and program coordinators to coordinate seamless service delivery.**

You will communicate updates, share documentation, and collaborate with team members to maintain consistency in support plans and services. Bilingual communication may also help strengthen coordination with Spanish-speaking families.

* **Set measurable weekly and monthly objectives to help individuals build communication, life, educational, and employment skills.**

You will help individuals establish achievable goals related to communication, daily living, education, employment, and personal development. Progress will be monitored and goals adjusted as needed, with support provided in the individual's preferred language when appropriate.

* **Track and document individual progress, support needs, and goals using internal agency systems.**

You will maintain accurate, timely, objective, and confidential records of individual progress, support needs, goals, observations, and follow-up requirements using agency systems.

* **Submit accurate monthly progress notes, service logs, and activity calendars in compliance with agency deadlines.**

You will complete and submit timely documentation reflecting sessions, training, coaching, educational support, and other services provided while following agency formats and deadlines.

* **Create accessible learning materials such as visual aids, slides, and training tools using Canva, Google Slides, or Pow

jobs.title: Licensed Clinical Social Worker - Parent/Caregiver Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Description**

The UCLA Health Rape Treatment Center provides specialized services for child and adult victims of sexual assault and abuse and conducts prevention, education, and professional training designed to reduce sexual violence and strengthen community response. Prevention programming includes education for youth and other community audiences, training and consultation for schools and partner organizations, and collaboration with community and professional systems.

Come join our outreach team as a Parent/Caregiver Program Coordinator and make a difference in the community. This key role will develop, coordinate, and deliver sexual abuse prevention education to parents and caregivers.

Key duties include:

* Identifying opportunities to reach parent/caregiver audiences through community organizations, healthcare, schools and child-serving settings, and other community-based venues
* Assesses prevention-education needs and develops programming responsive to those needs.
* Creating and adapting prevention curricula and materials, facilitating workshops and trainings, developing community partnerships, evaluating program effectiveness, and contributing to ongoing program improvement.
* Uses trauma informed approaches to respond appropriately to disclosures, connect families with clinical advocacy and community resources and supports caregiver engagement services.
* Contributes to grant reporting and data requirements.
* Regularly travels to local schools, community organizations, partner agencies, and other program sites throughout Los Angeles County; occasionally travel outside the local area may be required for training, meetings, or other program-related activities.
* Participation in the RTC/Stuart House 24-hour on-call response system, including approximately 1-2 weekday overnight on-call shifts per month.

UCLA Health is a world-renowned health system with four award-winning hospitals and dozens of primary care practices, specialty practices, urgent care centers and other ancillary locations throughout metro Los Angeles. We are also home to the David Geffen School of Medicine, an internationally respected leader in medical education and research. Through the efforts of our outstanding people, we have become Los Angeles’ trusted provider of exceptional, compassionate patient care.

Pay Range: $58.41 - $69.80 hourly

  
Pay range: $58.41 - $69.80 an hour  
  
**Qualifications**

**Required:**

* Master of Social Work (MSW) degree from an accredited institution and current California Licensed Clinical Social Worker (LCSW)
* Bilingual English/Spanish proficiency sufficient to deliver prevention programming and communicate effectively with participants (ability to successfully complete the UCLA language proficiency assessment)
* 2+ years providing education, support, outreach or programming primarily to parent/caregivers or families
* Experience developing and facilitating educational programs, workshops, curricula, or training materials
* Experience in childhood trauma, child sexual abuse, or related prevention programming
* Live Scan Fingerprint screening, Criminal Record, Sex Offender Registry, and Child Abuse Index Clearance
* Per funding agency requirements and alliances, all staff must complete background checks at least every five years that includes, sex offender registry check, State or FBI criminal history check, including fingerprint check, child abuse and neglect state registry check if available in the state of California.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with parents/caregivers, schools, community organizations, healthcare providers, and multidisciplinary partners.
* Strong written communication, organizational, project-management, and documentation skills.
* Ability to work independently in community and off-site settings while managing multiple concurrent activities and deadlines.

**Preferred:** Experience working with parents/caregivers and community-based organizations.

jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Company Information**

AEG brings music, sports, and live entertainment together to create moments people remember around the world. Each year, more than 100 million fans experience live events across five continents—from global touring, concerts, and festivals to iconic sports and entertainment destinations.

Through our music division, AEG Presents, one of the world's leading operators of tours, concerts, and music festivals, we help shape the sound of now. We work with artists at every stage of their careers to bring live music to life, connecting artists with fans on stages around the world.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, AEG Presents is driven by creativity, innovation, and purpose, and powered by people who want their work to show up in the real world.

If you're ready to help create moments that matter, there's a place for you here. Because it happens here.

**Job Summary**

The Social Media Coordinator supports the planning, creation, scheduling, and publishing of engaging digital content across multiple social media platforms and venue accounts. This role assists with content calendars, copywriting, video editing, media organization, digital advertising assets, and influencer campaign support while maintaining effective communication with project managers and the marketing team. The position helps ensure consistent, timely, and brand-aligned social media and digital marketing efforts across all assigned channels.

**What you will do**

* Oversees and maintains various social media accounts across all platforms – Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, Pinterest
* Devises a consistent content calendar across multiple venues, which includes filling, scheduling, and publishing assets live
* Edits sizzle reels, Instagram Reels, and TikToks. Create and edit basic motion graphics, animations, and visual effects content using Adobe Premiere Pro and/or Adobe After Effects to support video, marketing, and digital media projects.
* Develops engaging copy for captions, press releases, headlines, and calls-to-action (CTAs)
* Organizes and audits media content across multiple venues
* Assists with Social Media ad building, Digital Media buying, and creating Newsletter/Email Blast assets
* Supports influencer campaign strategy and outreach
* Maintains effective communication between project managers and marketing department for content scheduling

**Required Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or its equivalency (BA/BS Degree Preferred) in communications, media, or advertisement
* 2-4 years Experience as a media coordinator or similar field
* Knowledge in developing appropriate media content across various platforms
* Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro and Photoshop; Adobe After Effects proficiency preferred
* Ability to foster long-term relationships with vendors, clients, and various business relationships
* Creative thinker with strong conceptual and research skills
* A natural leader who displays strong decision-making and attention to detail
* Ability to work under pressure and meet deadlines
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and writing skills
* Basic understanding of budgeting and advertisement skills
* Must be able to have basic animation skills in either Adobe Premiere Pro or After Effects
* Familiarity with social media platforms

**Payscale: $21.79 - $30.85**

**Bonus:** *This position is not eligible for a bonus under the current bonus plan requirements.*

**Benefits:** ***Full-time:*** *We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, paid holidays, vacation and sick time, company paid basic life insurance, voluntary life insurance, parental leave, 401k Plan (with a current employer match of 3%), flexible spending and health savings account options, and wellness offerings.*

AEG reserves the right to change or modify the employee's job description whether orally or in writing, at any time during the employment relationship. AEG may require an employee to perform duties outside their normal description.

AEG's policy is to hire the most qualified applicants, and we comply with all applicable federal, state and local employment laws in making hiring and employee decisions. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate against applicants or employees on the basis of race, color, marital status, disability, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status recognized by applicable federal, state or local law.

  

Employer does not offer work visa sponsorship for this position.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator - Pomona Housing
jobs.description:
HealthRIGHT 360 gives hope, builds health, and changes lives for people in need by providing comprehensive, integrated, compassionate care that includes primary medical care, mental health services, and substance use disorder treatment.
  
This is a union-eligible position.
  
**The required shift for this position is:** M-F 9:30AM-6PM (can be flexible anytime 8AM-7PM)
  
  
JOB SUMMARY
  
HealthRIGHT 360, a nonprofit organization and a family of programs, is committed to providing accessible and comprehensive healthcare services to vulnerable populations. Our mission is to tackle systemic barriers to healthcare and promote health equity for all. We offer a wide range of services, including mental health care, residential and outpatient substance use treatment, and primary health services. Additionally, we provide transitional support for individuals re-entering the community after involvement in the criminal justice system. By integrating physical and behavioral health, we empower individuals to overcome challenges by addressing social determinants of health, fostering resilience, and facilitating recovery.
  
  
Building on this mission, the Prototypes Housing, a program of HealthRIGHT 360, provides housing and case management services for women and women with children across Los Angeles County through three core programs that support clients along the housing continuum. Recovery Bridge Housing (RBH) offers short-term, recovery-focused interim housing for unhoused adults and perinatal women engaged in outpatient substance use treatment, emphasizing life skills development within a 90-day period to promote long-term stability. The Bridge Housing program serves individuals with behavioral health needs who are experiencing homelessness by providing interim housing and supportive services until they secure permanent placement. The Continuum of Care (COC), funded through LAHSA, delivers permanent housing solutions focused on sustained stability for individuals and families experiencing homelessness. Across all programs, Prototypes provides comprehensive case management, including assessments, individualized service planning, resource linkage, and ongoing support to help clients achieve lasting recovery and housing stability.
  
  
Aligned with HealthRIGHT 360’s mission to advance health equity and the Prototypes Housing continuum serving women and families across Los Angeles County, the Administrative Coordinator supports daily operations that ensure safe, stable housing by maintaining housing readiness, tracking client census and bed availability, coordinating unit turnover, and managing maintenance requests. This role also supports administrative functions by maintaining documentation systems, managing workflows and supply levels, and coordinating communication across multidisciplinary teams to support efficient service delivery and positive client housing outcomes in alignment with HealthRIGHT 360’s mission and values.
  
  
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
Housing Operations Support
  

* Maintain daily client census and track bed availability to support admissions and program flow.
* Ensure unit readiness by coordinating room turnover, cleanliness, and appropriate housing conditions.
* Submit and track maintenance requests; follow up to ensure timely completion of repairs. This may include traveling to off-site RBH locations in Pomona.
* Collaborate with supervisors and managers to optimize housing utilization and client placement.
* Maintain inventory of housing supplies including toiletries, linens, and bedding.
* Monitor supply levels and coordinate replenishment to ensure consistent availability for clients.
* Organize and manage storage areas to ensure accessibility and efficiency.
* Transport clients if necessary.

Office Support
  

* Maintain office organization, including filing systems and administrative processes.
* Support overall office efficiency by coordinating tasks and improving workflow systems.
* Assist with documentation and internal administrative tracking as needed.

Collaboration
  

* Serve as a liaison between administrative offices and program departments, including Outpatient and Residential teams.
* Facilitate clear and consistent communication to support daily operations and client care.
* Work closely with supervisors and management to address operational needs and priorities.

Compliance
  

* Maintain and uphold all applicable HIPAA and 42 CFR Part 2 regulations.
* Ensure confidentiality and secure handling of client and organizational information.
* Follow all organizational policies and procedures related to documentation and privacy.
* Attend and complete assigned trainings.
* Attend and participate in meetings and events.
* Read and respond to emails in a timely manner.

And perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
QUALIFICATIONS
  
Credentials
  

* High school diploma or equivalent required. Higher education preferred.
* Valid First Aid and CPR certification or ability to obtain within the required timeline.
* Valid California Driver’s License and access to registered and insured transportation.

Experience
  

* Minimum of two years’ experience in an administrative or clerical role.
* Experience and demonstrated proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).

jobs.description:
**Home Health Administrative Coordinator**

**Location:** Burbank, CA 91502  
**Position Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced and highly organized **Home Health Administrative Coordinator** to join our growing home health team. The ideal candidate must have **prior home health experience** and be knowledgeable in daily agency operations, patient intake, staff scheduling, coordination of care, and office administration. This position requires excellent communication, multitasking, and customer service skills.

Responsibilities

* Manage patient intake and admission processes.
* Answer and direct incoming phone calls from patients, physicians, referral sources, and staff.
* Coordinate and schedule skilled nursing, therapy, and home health aide visits.
* Maintain clinician schedules and assist with staffing coordination.
* Process referrals and obtain necessary documentation from physicians and facilities.
* Verify insurance information and assist with authorization tracking.
* Maintain accurate patient records and ensure compliance with agency policies.
* Coordinate communication between patients, caregivers, clinicians, and referral sources.
* Assist with office operations, filing, data entry, and administrative support.
* Monitor and follow up on outstanding orders, physician signatures, and documentation.
* Support management with daily operational tasks and special projects.

Qualifications

* **Minimum 1-2 years of Home Health Administrative experience required.**
* Strong understanding of home health operations, patient intake, scheduling, and coordination of care.
* Experience working with EMR systems preferred (DSL).
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
* Professional, compassionate, and patient-focused attitude.

Preferred Skills

* Home health intake and referral management.
* Staff scheduling and coordination.
* Insurance verification and authorization knowledge.
* Understanding of Medicare and home health regulations.
* Strong customer service and problem-solving skills.

Benefits

* Competitive salary based on experience.
* Paid time off and holidays.
* Supportive team environment.

**To Apply:** Please submit your resume highlighting your home health administrative experience, intake coordination, scheduling, and office management background.

**Home Health experience is required. Applicants without home health experience will not be considered.**

Pay: $20.00 - $25.00 per hour

Work Location: In person

* Cybersecurity posture improvements and compliance initiatives
* Professional services and project delivery
* Expansion of managed services and recurring service agreements
* Hardware, licensing, and platform optimization aligned to GoodSuite standards

Each TAM is expected to maintain a forward-looking project pipeline at all times, with multiple project opportunities actively in progress, ensuring ongoing modernization, security maturity improvements, and infrastructure alignment with GoodSuite best practices.

* Ensure lifecycle planning for critical infrastructure including servers, networking, security platforms, and endpoint environments
* Maintain an active multi-year technology roadmap for each client

**Strategic Account Management**

* Own the long-term strategic relationship with assigned clients including executive and operational stakeholders
* Maintain a living technology roadmap and improvement plan for each account
* Conduct structured Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) reviewing roadmap progress, service trends, and upcoming initiatives
* Identify and advance technology

jobs.title: Account Manager – Aerospace
jobs.description:
**About Us**

OMI Specialty Products is a leading aerospace supplier with a proud history dating back to 1968. We provide aerospace parts, hardware, chemicals, and raw materials to OEMs, MROs, airlines, and their suppliers in both civil and defense applications, serving customers around the world. Our commitment to excellence, responsiveness, and integrity has made us a trusted partner across the industry.

**The Role**

We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented Account Manager to join our inside sales team. You will own a book of customer accounts — turning RFQs into competitive quotes, sourcing parts from suppliers, and making sure every order ships complete and on time. This is a fast-paced, high-volume role for someone who likes solving problems, works well with a team, and wants to grow a career in aerospace sales.

**What You’ll Do**

* **Quote fast and accurately:** Respond to customer RFQs with competitive, accurate quotes in our ERP system, typically within the same business day.
* **Source parts:** Find pricing and availability using our sales history, ILS, and our supplier network; negotiate price and lead time with vendors.
* **Manage your accounts:** Build relationships with buyers at your assigned customers, follow up on open quotes, and grow your accounts by cross-selling OMI’s parts, hardware, chemicals, and raw materials.
* **Own the order:** Work with procurement, expediting, quality, and shipping to keep orders on track; resolve issues such as rejections, shortages, lead-time changes, and returns.
* **Get the paperwork right:** Ensure orders meet customer and aerospace quality requirements, including traceability, certifications, and documentation.
* **Stay compliant:** Follow OMI’s export-compliance procedures (ITAR/EAR), including customer and end-use screening.
* **Keep data clean:** Maintain accurate customer, quote, and order records in the ERP.
* **Step up:** Support the team and lead day-to-day activity in the sales manager’s absence.

**What You Bring**

* Minimum 3-5 years of sales, account management, or customer service experience in the aerospace distribution industry, or a bachelor’s degree in business or a related field with a strong interest in aerospace sales.
* Experience in aerospace distribution, OEMs, MRO, and/or brokering is a strong plus.
* Familiarity with ILS, PartsBase, Aeroxchange or Quantum Control is a plus.
* Comfortable with margins, markups, and percentages; strong Microsoft Excel and Outlook skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication; professional and responsive with customers and vendors.
* Organized and detail-oriented, able to manage many open quotes and orders at once.
* A team player who works well across sales, purchasing, quality, and shipping.
* Additional languages are a plus.

**What We Offer**

* Base salary plus performance bonus
* Career growth in a growing, global company
* A high-performing, supportive team
* On-site employee gym and recreation area
* On-site micro market

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance (including family coverage)
* Life insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off, paid sick leave, and paid company holidays

**Compensation**

Competitive base salary and benefits, plus performance bonus. Actual pay depends on experience and qualifications.

**Location**

Fullerton, California.

**Additional Information**

This position requires access to technology and technical data subject to U.S. export control laws (ITAR/EAR). Applicants must be U.S. persons (U.S. citizens, lawful permanent residents, or protected individuals) or be eligible to obtain any required U.S. government authorization.

OMI Specialty Products is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. We will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act. We provide reasonable accommodation to qualified individuals with disabilities.

From industry-leading molecules to sustainable innovations, Milliken creates products that enhance people’s lives and deliver solutions for its customers and communities. Drawing on thousands of patents and a portfolio with applications across the textile, flooring, chemical and healthcare businesses, the company harnesses a shared sense of integrity and excellence to positively impact the world for generations. Discover more about Milliken’s curious minds and inspired solutions at Milliken.com and on Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn.

  

**POSITION TITLE**

Strategic Account Manager – Advanced Wound Care – Southwest

  

**POSITION OVERVIEW**

OVIK Health seeks a results-driven Account Manager to grow advanced wound care sales across the Southwest. This role develops new business and expands product utilization within hospitals, wound care centers, burn centers, long-term care, home health, and DME accounts.

Using consultative selling, this role will educate clinicians and decision-makers on OVIK Health wound care solutions, support appropriate product use, and execute territory plans to achieve sales goals.

This field-based role requires candidates to reside near a major airport in the Southwest region, preferably in Los Angeles, San Diego, or Phoenix. Candidates based in Salt Lake City or other locations may also be considered. Approximately 75% of travel is required, including overnight stays.

  

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Drive Ovik sales growth and achieve territory targets through focused account development and customer support.
* Develop territory and account plans that prioritize Ovik growth opportunities.
* Build relationships with clinicians, administrators, purchasing teams, and key decision-makers.
* Win new accounts and expand Ovik product utilization within existing customers.
* Lead customer meetings, product demonstrations, and clinical education that highlight Ovik’s value.
* Advance opportunities efficiently from prospecting through conversion and ongoing account growth.
* Attend sales meetings, product training, medical conferences, trade shows, and other customer or professional development events as needed.
* Partner with Clinical, Marketing, Customer Service, and Operations to support customers.
* Maintain accurate CRM activity, pipeline updates, forecasts, and market insights.
* Conduct business in compliance with applicable healthcare compliance requirements, company policies, ethical standards, and quality system expectations.
  

**QUALIFICATIONS - REQUIRED**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or a related field.
* At least 2 years of relevant sales experience with a demonstrated record of execution and results; healthcare, medical device, pharmaceutical, or clinical sales experience is strongly preferred.
* Candidates should possess established relationships within major integrated delivery networks (IDNs) and health systems
* Demonstrated ability to leverage existing relationships to engage key clinical, supply chain, and executive decision-makers is highly preferred.
* Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills with healthcare providers and executive stakeholders.
* Proven ability to manage a territory, prioritize demands, organize customer activity, and follow through.
* Strong initiative, problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
* Ability to work independently in the field and collaborate effectively with the team.
* Ability to quickly learn and communicate technical product information and clinical value.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM platforms, databases, and business software.
* Valid driver’s license and ability to travel by car and air, including overnight travel (approximately 50–70%).
  

**QUALIFICATIONS - PREFERRED**

* Experience selling into hospitals, wound care centers, burn centers, long-term care, home health, or DME organizations.
* Experience with consultative, solution-based, or concept selling in a clinical or technical environment.
* Experience using Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics, or a comparable CRM platform.
* Experience providing product demonstrations, customer education, or in-service presentations.
  

The base salary range for this position is $72,560 to $126,981; the exact salary depends on several factors such as experience, skills, education, and budget. In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for participation in a highly competitive bonus program with possibility for overachievement based on performance and company results and eligibility to participate in our long-term incentive program.

In addition, the Company offers the following benefits: [e.g., health insurance, wellness and family support programs, life and disability insurance, retirement savings plans, paid leave programs, education related programs, paid holidays and vacation time]. Some of these benefits have eligibility requirements. Many of these benefits are subsidized or fully paid for by the Company.

Milliken is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, sex or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth or related medical condition, including but not limited to lactation), sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression (including transgender status), ancestry, national origin, citizenship, age physical or mental disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

To request a reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, a job interview, or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact TalentAcquisition@milliken.com.

jobs.description:
**THE·TEAM is proud to provide representation and marketing services to talent, brands and properties across 28 countries and more than 70 cities worldwide.**

  

**Shaped by our belief in the unifying power of sports, music and entertainment, THE·TEAM leads with intelligence, ideas and influence. For more information, please visit** **the.team** **.**

  

**JOB OVERVIEW:**

We’re looking for an ambitious and driven Social Media Manager to lead strategy and storytelling for @the.team.nfl , THE·TEAM’s dedicated Football social platform. This role will oversee social content highlighting THE·TEAM’s football ecosystem across high school, college and the NFL, including our talent representation, NIL, marketing, partnerships and cross-disciplinary work across sports and entertainment.

  

If you’re passionate about the intersection of American football, athletes and culture, this is a strong opportunity to make an impact.

  

A key focus of this role will be managing and evolving content approaches across player moments, signings, NIL, gamedays, the NFL Draft, free agency, partnerships and other major moments across the football calendar.

  

THE·TEAM works in a fast-paced environment, so the ideal candidate will be able to hit the ground running, thrive in a demanding and often reactive sports environment and work brilliantly in a team environment, while being equally comfortable working independently.

  

**WHAT YOU’LL DO:**
-------------------

* Lead social strategy and content planning for @the.team.nfl, with clear channel roles, content pillars and a repeatable testing framework across Instagram and potential emerging platforms.
* Tell the broader story of THE·TEAM’s football ecosystem across high school, college and the NFL.
* Proactively develop and execute content calendars aligned with player moments, partnerships and business priorities.
* Translate athlete stories, client wins, cultural moments and brand initiatives into engaging, social-first storytelling.
* Manage content building, copywriting, post publishing, community engagement and performance tracking.
* Develop and scale content around key American football moments including signings, NIL announcements, gamedays, the NFL Draft, free agency, training camp, the regular season, playoffs and the Super Bowl.
* Work closely with THE·TEAM’s football talent representation teams to understand individual player journeys, emerging talent, business priorities and opportunities for storytelling.
* Work closely with the global communications department to execute and uphold THE·TEAM’s overall marketing and communications strategy.
* Collaborate with Creative to produce high-impact, social-first content across formats including graphics, short-form video, carousels and real-time content.
* Build creative and editorial frameworks to ensure content is culturally relevant, engaging and consistent with the account’s evolving visual identity.
* Identify trends, moments and stories that can attract new audiences, showcase our talent and demonstrate THE·TEAM’s expertise within American football.
* Balance client expectations and stakeholder needs with overarching brand goals, direction and guidelines.
Travel onsite for key moments in the football calendar to create compelling content born out of integration with events, teams and clients.  

  

**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
---------------------------

* 2+ years of agency-side or brand experience developing social media creative, editing copy and engaging with an audience.
* A Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Communications or a related field.
* Strong organizational and project management skills, with experience using tools like Asana or similar platforms to manage workflows and deadlines.
* Familiarity with native Instagram/LinkedIn Insights and CMS tools like Sprinklr.
* Extensive knowledge of social media best practices and emerging trends.
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong relationship-management skills, internally and with clients.
* High standard of excellence, with the flexibility to work nontraditional hours when needed and anticipate challenges with thoughtful communication.
* Flawless spelling and grammar.
* Video capture, editing, production and on-camera abilities using tools such as CapCut, Edits and Premiere Pro.
* Strong awareness of cultural trends across sports, music and entertainment.
* Proficiency in Google Suite, Keynote, Slack and Box.
An insatiable passion for and extensive knowledge of American football, including the NFL, college football, NIL and the broader football landscape.

jobs.title: Studio Site & Social Media Manager (Part-Time)
jobs.description:
The studio is hiring a **part-time Studio Site & Social Media Manager** with flexible hours, at **$22–$26/hour** plus overtime. The role has two equal halves: running the studio floor on shoot days, and running the studio’s social media.

On site, you’ll check productions in and wrap them out, keep the stage clean and stocked, and take care of clients while they shoot. Online, you’ll turn what happens here into content that brings filmmakers, photographers, musicians and brands through our doors. We want someone who loves this space and wants to help build a real community of creatives around the studio and its almost 11-year history.

Responsibilities

**1. Studio site management (core)**

* Open the studio and check in productions: walk them through the space, power, house rules and safety.
* Check house gear in and out (grip, electric, furniture, props) against each booking.
* Run check in and wrap out: note add ons and damage, missing items or overtime, confirm the space is restored, trash is out and close out the booking.
* Be the on-site point of contact while clients shoot: answer questions, solve problems, troubleshoot G&E basics.
* Light cleaning and reset between bookings: floors, touch-ups, green room and restrooms.
* Track inventory of gear, expendables and supplies; flag repairs and reorder needs.

**2. Social media and content (core)**

* Own the studio’s social channels: plan, shoot, edit and post content on a regular schedule.
* Capture behind-the-scenes photos and video on shoot days, with client permission.
* Train other staff to capture behind-the-scenes content.
* Grow followers and engagement, and showcase the studio to production companies, labels and agencies.
* Track what’s working and share simple monthly results.

**3. Community and growth**

* Log client contacts, bookings and follow-ups in HubSpot.
* Introduce production companies, music labels, and marketing and ad agencies to the studio.
* Help plan and host community events, meetups and screenings.

What we’re looking for

**Required**

* Proven social media skills: shooting and editing short-form video, posting consistently and growing an audience. Please share accounts you’ve run and metrics.
* Studio site management and/or film, commercial or photo production experience.
* Comfortable being the point person with clients: calm, friendly and solution-focused under pressure.
* Organized and detail-oriented with check-ins, inventory and paperwork.
* Able to lift 30 lbs.

**Preferred**

* Experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
* Comfortable with photo and video editing tools.
* Working knowledge of grip and electric: stands, flags, rigging basics, lighting, power distribution and set safety.

**Bonus points**

* An existing network of production companies, music labels, and marketing and advertising agencies.
* A genuine desire to help build a community of creatives around the studio.

Schedule and pay

* **Employment type:** Part-time, hourly, non-exempt (W-2)
* **Hours:** About 10–40 hours per week, depending on bookings
* **Shift length:** 4–13 hours, based on bookings
* **Pay:** $22–$26/hour (good-faith range, based on experience)
* **Overtime:** 1.5x after 8 hours a day or 40 a week; 2x after 12 hours a day
* **Location:** On site, Downtown LA (DTLA) area

This is a part-time role with flexible hours. Expect some early calls, late wraps and weekends.

How to apply

Send your resume to **siterepjob@gmail.com**. Include links to social accounts you’ve run (with metrics), a few lines on why this role interests you and the community you’d bring with you, and your general weekly availability.

The studio is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of every background and will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative and the California Fair Chance Act.

Pay: $22.00 - $26.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 10.0 per week

Benefits:

* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
* Los Angeles, California, United States

* Marketing and Promotion

* Regular

**Title:** Social Media Manager

**Department:** Marketing and Promotion

**Duration:** Indefinite

**Employment Status:** Exempt, Full-Time

  

**Job Summary**

Reporting to the Director, Marketing Strategy and Operations, the Social Media Manager is responsible for the College’s digital storytelling and social media strategy across institutional channels, including Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, and other emerging platforms. The Manager advances the College’s marketing and communications objectives through strategic content development that engages prospective students, deepens connections within the campus community, promotes institutional priorities, and elevates the College’s brand. The Manager identifies storytelling opportunities and translates institutional priorities into platform-specific campaigns and content. The Manager develops and executes the content published across institutional social media channels, administering content ideation, planning, production, copywriting, photography, videography, editing, publishing, and performance analysis. The Manager serves as the College’s social media advisor for campus partners on best practices, content strategy, and effective channel use while ensuring alignment with institutional brand goals. The Manager oversees the department's team of student employees supporting Marketing and Communications initiatives, providing direction, training, project management, and professional development opportunities while ensuring high-quality creative output across departmental needs.

  

**Job Duties**

* 50% - Creates and manages content for the College’s social media platforms, including platform-specific copywriting, video production, content editing, and channel optimization. Oversee student-created content and coordinates photography and visual asset requests with internal and external vendors to support brand and marketing objectives. - (Essential)
* 10% - Utilize analytics to drive decision making and improve marketing effectiveness in respective channels. Prepare quarterly reports on social media performance to the vice president. - (Essential)
* 10% - Supervises student employees by assigning and overseeing department-specific projects aligned with institutional brand standards and departmental goals, including review and approval of timesheets and work deliverables. - (Essential)
* 10% - Oversee the planning, development, and execution of internal newsletters (On Campus, Oxy Essentials, Oswald's Weekly Watch) for faculty, staff, and student audiences, ensuring consistent and effective communication of campus news, initiatives, and opportunities. - (Essential)
* 5% - Serve as the College’s social media advisor for campus partners on best practices, content strategy, and effective channel use while ensuring alignment with institutional brand goals, including leading campus Social Media Communicators Group through quarterly meetings. - (Marginal)
* 5% - Leads internally managed paid social media advertising efforts, including campaign strategy, budget management, audience targeting, and performance optimization across platforms. - (Marginal)
* 5% - Lead video production projects as producer from concept through distribution, including identifying and managing external vendors, outlining project scope and timelines, scripting, and providing editorial direction. Reviews and approves all video cuts and develops platform-specific publishing strategies, including audience targeting, timing, and channel optimization. - (Marginal)
* 5% - Oversee Canva Enterprise licenses and act as primary liaison with ITS for this technology subscription. - (Marginal)
  

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in communications, marketing, public relations, journalism, digital media, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Five years of progressively responsible experience in marketing and communications, including three years of experience in social media and e-mail marketing.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Google Drives/Folders/Forms, Adobe Acrobat, web editing, social media applications, email marketing platforms, and other productivity programs applicable to position responsibilities.
* Expertise managing social media platforms including Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, TikTok, and Instagram, including technical knowledge, content strategy, content development, and channel optimization.

**ThinkCulinary LLC.**

ThinkCulinary is seeking a highly organized, detail oriented **Inside Sales Coordinator** to support our growing sales operation. This is an office-based position that plays a critical role in keeping day-to-day sales activities running smoothly while supporting our outside sales executives, customers, warehouse team, and logistics partners.

* **Order Management:** Receive, enter, track, and verify customer orders while ensuring accuracy and proper inventory allocation.

* **Logistics Coordination:** Request and compare freight quotes, book carriers, track shipments, manage ETAs, and communicate delays or delivery issues.

* **Credits & Account Support:** Prepare credit memos and supporting documentation when necessary to resolve customer payment discrepancies.
* **Product Knowledge:** Develop a strong understanding of ThinkCulinary's products, brands, pricing, inventory levels, and customer usage patterns.

**We are looking for someone who is:**

* Highly organized with strong attention to detail
* Comfortable managing multiple priorities and deadlines

They are a key liaison between customers, carriers, customs authorities, and internal stakeholders to ensure freight moves efficiently, compliantly, and cost effectively from origin to destination. They are highly organized, detail oriented, and capable of managing multiple shipments and priorities in a fast-paced logistics environment. They play a critical role in delivering exceptional service while supporting operational excellence and customer satisfaction.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate domestic and international freight shipments across air transportation modes.

* Manage the end-to-end forwarding process from shipment initiation through final delivery.

* Own the complete shipment process in CargoWise, including data entry, pickup and delivery scheduling, AES entry, airline bookings, routing, operational milestone updates, and costing.

* Ensure all customers' SOP instructions are adhered to, and internal/company KPIs and guidelines are and met.

* Prepare, review, and process shipping documentation including bills of lading, commercial invoices, packing lists, airway bills, and other transportation documents.

* Communicate proactively with customers, carriers, customs brokers, steamship lines, airlines, trucking providers, and internal teams regarding shipment status and requirements.

* Track and monitor freight movements to ensure timely pickup, transit, customs clearance, and delivery.

* Support import and export compliance by maintaining accurate shipment records and ensuring adherence to applicable regulations and trade requirements.

* Coordinate customs clearance activities and work closely with customs brokers and government agencies as needed.

* Identify and resolve transportation delays, documentation discrepancies, customs holds, and other shipment-related issues.

* Provide customers with shipment updates, quotes, service options, and solutions to support their logistics needs.

* Maintain accurate data and shipment information within transportation management and operational systems.

* Assist with carrier selection, routing decisions, and cost-effective transportation solutions.

* Support continuous improvement efforts related to service levels, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure a seamless customer experience and successful shipment execution.

* All other duties as assigned to meet evolving business needs.

**Qualifications**

* Education: High school diploma or equivalent required; additional logistics, transportation, supply chain, or business coursework preferred.

* Certification/Licensure: No specific certification required; industry certifications related to freight forwarding, import/export, customs, or logistics are a plus.

* Experience: 2+ years of direct experience in freight forwarding required

* Specialized experience in import operations, customs brokerage, and international logistics preferred.

* Experience supporting air freight operations strongly preferred.

* Prior working experience with CargoWise TMS and similar cloud-based transportation management/logistics platforms preferred.

* Working knowledge of international shipping documentation, transportation processes, and import/export procedures.

* Ability to manage multiple shipments, priorities, and deadlines in a fast-paced operational environment.

* Strong communication and customer service skills with the ability to build relationships across customers, carriers, and internal stakeholders.

* Excellent attention to detail and problem-solving skills with the ability to identify and resolve shipment issues efficiently.

* Demonstrated discretion and confidentiality in handling and protecting sensitive information.

* Technical: Proficient with common office technologies, including Windows PCs, Microsoft O365 (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.) and web conferencing (Teams, Zoom, Webex, etc.)

* Environment: Comfort commuting to/from and working in a 100% on-site setting (listed in this posting).

* Experience in hardware, AI infrastructure, cloud or another technology company

Gimlet is expanding from its core technology into a production neocloud spanning new hardware, customers, and data centers.

jobs.description:
**About Pendulum**

Pendulum® is leading a revolution that is occurring around the world to improve physical and mental health by first understanding, then restoring and enhancing the human microbiome.

Studies have shown that our microbiome (the bacterial communities in and on our bodies) is linked to everything from metabolism and diabetes, to longevity, weight loss, healthy immune systems, cancer prevention, feelings of well-being, inflammatory bowel disease, and even healthy skin. We have just scratched the surface on understanding the impact that our microbiome has on our lives. During early life we develop a diverse and balanced microbiome that plays a critical role in shaping our long-term health. Over our lives, a combination of diet, lifestyle, antibiotics, and aging can decrease the effectiveness of our microbiome.

Pendulum recognized the enormous impact they could have on people’s lives if they were able to address the imbalances in the microbiome. To accomplish this, Pendulum created proprietary probiotic pipelines and a unique discovery platform to identify key, novel bacterial strains and the prebiotics that feed them. The company has also built and developed the world’s first manufacturing technology to produce bacteria in an anaerobic (oxygen-free) environment at scale.

The medical probiotics that Pendulum has formulated have transformed the consumer probiotics market into a new category of therapeutic offerings that deliver the power and efficacy of a pharmaceutical with the safety and accessibility of a natural probiotic. Due to Pendulum’s explosive revenue and customer growth over the last two years, the company earned a spot on Forbes Magazine’s exclusive “The Next Billion Dollar Startups” list.

Barry’s is the Best Workout in the WorldTM®. Founded in West Hollywood in 1998, it’s the original strength and cardio interval fitness experience that provides an immersive, high-intensity, one-hour workout that’s as effective as it is fun. Our fitness classes alternate between working out with weights and running on a treadmill. Each day focuses on a different muscle group in order to achieve real results and to prevent injuries. Our program is designed to tone muscle and maximize fat loss, while spiking the metabolism for up to 48 hours following the class.

Please be aware that smoking is prohibited in all indoor areas of Barry’s studios and corporate offices.

**About the role**

Barry's grows one first class at a time. Someone walks in, finds their spot in the Red Room, and leaves knowing they'll be back. Your job is to create as many of those first classes as possible.

You'll own local event marketing across the New York market- in-studio community nights and bring-a-friend classes, plus out-of-studio pop-ups, run clubs, and partnerships with local brands, employers, and buildings. Every event is measured the same way: how many people took their first class because of it, and how many came back.

Event Execution

**Qualifications**

  

* 4+ years in community, field, or event marketing- ideally fitness, wellness, hospitality, or a consumer brand with physical locations

jobs.title: Field Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**About Plasmidsaurus**

Plasmidsaurus is on a mission to accelerate new cures and promote a healthier planet by unlocking a new level of productivity for scientists. Our sequencing services are used daily by thousands of innovators, including Nobel laureates, Fortune 100 pharma, and over 70,000 scientists.

We began by revolutionizing plasmid sequencing, making it exponentially cheaper and faster, with innovative sequencing technologies and a global network of laboratories that turn samples into answers in hours, not weeks.

Now we are expanding that same disruptive model across all of genomics. With the launch of our new RNA-seq service, we are taking a bold step toward our vision to sequence everything, providing scientists everywhere with faster, simpler, and more affordable access to the data that powers discovery.

Every team member at Plasmidsaurus plays a crucial role in driving the future of biotech research. Together, we are building the world’s most efficient sequencing engine that operates overnight, scales globally, and helps scientists make breakthroughs faster than ever before.

**Role Overview**
=================

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Merch, Events, and Brand Experience, you'll scale the in-person presence that puts our sequencing services directly in front of the scientists who use them every day. You'll own execution across our field marketing calendar, including major scientific conferences, sales account-based events, and a new North American roadshow program, turning each one into an on-brand touchpoint that builds pipeline and deepens trust with our scientific community.

This is a hands-on role for someone who's as comfortable packing a booth crate and running a load-in as they are building a run-of-show or briefing a booth team. We build our own booths and don't rely on external events agencies. Within your first year, you'll run a major conference on your own and build programs that don't exist yet.

Based in South San Francisco, 3 days a week in the office.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Tradeshow & Conference Execution**

* Plan and execute our tradeshow calendar of major scientific conferences and society meetings, such as ASHG, AACR, PAG, and ASM
* Design and build our booths, from layout to on-site setup
* Own booth logistics, shipping, signage, staffing schedules, and lead capture across single-booth, double-booth, and international formats
* Brief and direct booth teams of about 10, including scientists and executives, on messaging, demos, and goals
* Coordinate show organizers, general contractors, AV, and catering directly, on time and on budget
* Serve as event project manager before each show, coordinating across Marketing, Sales, Product, R&D, and leadership
* Take conferences on your own when the calendar overlaps

### **Field Marketing & Sales Events**

* Develop, plan, and execute field marketing programs: sales account-based events, roadshows, and regional user meetings
* Design and build a North American roadshow program from scratch
* Take sales-led events beyond today's playbook, raising the brand bar at each one
* Coordinate logistics from venue sourcing through teardown
* Align events with Sales account priorities and pipeline goals, and own lead handoff and follow-up
* Build a multi-channel outreach and promotional plan for each event
* Work with the social media team on event content, including attendee sharing

### **Operations & Reporting**

* Own budgets, vendor and venue coordination, contracts, timelines, and shipping
* Track leads, cost per lead, and attendee feedback, and use them to improve future events
* Help build and maintain the field marketing calendar and budget tracker, flagging risks early

### **Brand & On-Site Staffing**

* Work with Brand and Design so booths, signage, and collateral reflect our brand and voice
* Travel to events, including evenings and weekends around show dates, to lead setup, staffing, and teardown

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

### **The First Three Months**

You've worked our January conferences, including the prep, and know how our booth comes together. You’ve learned the process of running a conference from prep to execution to measurement and debrief, the Plasmidsaurus way.

### **Within Six Months**

You've worked four major conferences across single-booth, double-booth, and international formats and are ready to lead one. Booth teams, including senior staff, follow your direction with confidence.

### **Within One Year**

You've run a major conference on your own and supported every show on our calendar. Sales-led events get hands-on support and are as on-brand as our conferences. A North American roadshow program is designed and piloted, and every event feeds measurable pipeline. You're a right hand and thought partner to the team.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 3–5 years in field marketing, event marketing, or trade show and conference coordination
* Startup or scale-up experience strongly preferred; life science, genomics, or biotech background a plus
* Conference booth experience end to end preferred; retail pop-ups or brand activations also count
* Experience with field programs beyond the show floor (roadshows, user meetings, regional sales events) a plus
* End-to-end event logistics: shipping, show-site services, general contractors, AV, catering, and venue sourcing
* Budget tracking and vendor management, including contracts
* Lead capture, scoring, and handoff with Sales using Salesforce and HubSpot; Popl and Luma a plus
* Run-of-show, staffing schedules, and booth-team briefings
* Proficiency in Google Workspace
* Comfortable with hands-on booth builds with no install crew, including lifting 15+ lb boxes
* Experience working with large teams and senior leadership

**Ways of Working**
-------------------

**Build.** Creative and scrappy, you find ways to stand out against much larger competitors. You build program

jobs.description:
**Title:** Inbound Sales Development Representative

**Location:** San Francisco, CA (Hybrid)

**Compensation:** $50,000 - $52,500 base + uncapped commission

**Job Type:** Full-time

**About Us**

Demandforce, founded in 2003 and based in San Francisco, is an award-winning software company helping small businesses grow through smarter communication. Our platform includes marketing automation, appointment reminders, reputation management, and 24/7 online booking.

We’re a fast-paced, collaborative team committed to helping businesses thrive—and we’re growing fast! Our Sales Development Representatives work closely with Account Executives to understand prospective customers’ business needs, identify the right opportunities, and create a strong first experience with Demandforce.

**What’s in it for you:**

* $50,000 - $52,500 base salary + uncapped commission
* Paid training + 2-month commission guarantee
* Career advancement path to Account Executive
* Hands-on experience with sales tools and technology, including Salesforce and ZoomInfo
* Ongoing sales coaching and development
* A collaborative, supportive team environment
* Communication, discovery, and sales skills you can build on throughout your career

**Who You Are:**

* Motivated, competitive, and goal-oriented
* A strong conversationalist who can build rapport quickly
* Naturally curious and comfortable asking questions to understand what a prospect really needs
* Comfortable thinking on your feet and navigating unexpected questions
* Organized and able to manage multiple conversations, follow-ups, and lead sources at once
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
* Confident on the phone and comfortable communicating through phone, email, and live chat
* Able to recognize buying signals, uncover a prospect’s needs, and confidently guide the conversation toward a next step
* Coachable, open to feedback, and interested in continuously improving
* Resilient - not every conversation results in a meeting. You know when to push, when to pivot, and how to move on to the next opportunity
* Able to work independently and in a team

**How You’ll Do It:**

This is not a traditional cold-calling-only SDR role. You’ll be one of the first people prospective customers speak with when they contact Demandforce.

Throughout the day, you’ll respond to inbound leads from phone calls, website inquiries, live chat, marketing campaigns, and other channels while also completing outbound follow-up. The role averages approximately 65 inbound and outbound calls per day in addition to email and chat activity.

Some prospects will know exactly what they’re looking for. Others may simply know they have a problem they want to solve. Your job is to quickly understand what’s happening in their business, ask the right questions, communicate how Demandforce may be able to help, and determine whether it makes sense to schedule a deeper conversation with an Account Executive.

You’ll need to balance speed with quality. Responding quickly matters, but so does making each conversation count.

* Respond quickly to new inbound prospects and follow up consistently
* Build rapport and lead productive, consultative conversations
* Ask strong discovery questions to understand the prospect’s business, challenges, and priorities
* Identify qualified opportunities and confidently ask prospects to schedule a meeting
* Handle common questions and objections without getting thrown off
* Maintain organized follow-up across calls, email, chat, and sales tools
* Work closely with Account Executives to create a smooth handoff and give them useful context before each appointment
* Learn Demandforce’s products, customers, competitors, and the industries we serve
* Participate in ongoing coaching and development
* Meet activity, appointment-setting, and performance goals

**Benefits**

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* 401(k) with company match
* Paid time off + holidays
* FSA for medical and dependent care
* Life & disability insurance
* Commuter benefits, EAP, and more

We expect the compensation for this role to depend on your skills, qualifications, and experience. We encourage all interested candidates to apply.

In addition to our awesome culture, we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support the health and well-being of you and your family. Our benefits include health insurance options such as medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible spending accounts (FSA) for medical and dependent care, short-term and long-term disability insurance, and life and AD&D insurance. We also provide a 401(k) retirement savings plan with a company match, paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, commuter benefits as well as access to our Employee Assistance Program (EAP) and well-being coaching services. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.

We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.

If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

The Executive Assistant, Product Management (EA) will be responsible for directly supporting multiple VP-level executives within our Product Management organization, with the primary executive being the Senior Vice President, Product Management, who reports directly to the CEO.

Support for these senior executives consists of calendar management, expense management, booking domestic and international travel, and supporting organizational team meetings including but not limited to offsites, product events, leadership summits, and all-hands. Support of these senior executives also extend to coordination with their direct reports, such as managing communication channels (Slack, Google Groups) and team meeting cadences.

**What You'll Bring to the Team:**

Atomic Machines is building the Matter Compiler™, the first in a new class of AI-native, all-digital manufacturing systems that build working machines directly from code. The Matter Compiler™ is aimed at micro-machines: motors and gears the size of a grain of sand, robots small enough to work inside the body, cooling built directly into the chips that run AI, and the many devices like them that have been waiting on a way to build them. Its first product is PrimeSwitch™, an electromechanical power relay the size of a button battery that carries 150 amps continuous current and opens in 50 microseconds, about a thousand times faster than a conventional contactor. Founded by Jeff Holden — serial entrepreneur, ex-Amazon SVP and Uber's first Chief Product Officer — the company has raised $250 million to date.

Atomic Machines is based in the San Francisco Bay Area, with offices in Emeryville and Santa Clara.

### **About The Role:**

You'll be the operational backbone behind both leaders, managing calendars, travel, meetings, expenses, and projects, freeing them to focus on their highest-impact work. This role requires someone who can move fluidly between two different functions and working styles, partnering closely with each executive and their respective teams. We're looking for someone proactive, trustworthy, and hyper-organized who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment. If that's you, we'd love to hear from you.

### **What You'll Do:**

* 7+ years of Executive Assistant experience, including direct experience supporting Sr. Director-level and above leadership; experience supporting multiple executives across different functions is a strong plus.

Familiarity with engineering workflows and terminology (e.g., program reviews, sprint planning, hardware/software development cycles) as well as GTM cadences (e.g., pipeline reviews, customer meetings, launch planning) is a strong plus.
* Polished presence and professional demeanor, you represent both executives with care in every interaction, written or in-person.

**Job Description**
-------------------

Transportation Planning and Management (TPM) is responsible for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods on the City's streets, supporting the larger goals of economic and social vitality for people living, working, and doing business in New York City. The Division’s responsibilities include planning, street design, technical analysis, signs, transit development, freight mobility, and markings, ensuring the safety of motor vehicle occupants, pedestrians, and cyclists.
  
  
The Office of Livable Streets (OLS) is tasked with prioritizing strategic planning, community engagement, research, policy, design, implementation, and long-term management. Their goal is to create streets that are livable, supporting safety, accessibility, inclusion, resiliency, active modes, community cohesion, and economic vitality citywide. Additionally, they aim to enhance New York City's pedestrian, bicycle, and micromobility networks, providing comfortable, connected, green, and reliable transportation options across the five boroughs. They place special emphasis on Priority Investment Areas, mode shift, and reimagining streets. The office also develops innovative new programs, design typologies, project delivery, and analysis tools to meet the demands of a rapidly changing population with evolving needs and technologies.
  
  
The Cycling & Micromobility Unit is responsible for the nation's largest network of on-street bicycle facilities (1,200+ lane-miles), enhancing street safety for all users, and increasing bike ridership in the five boroughs. The team's focus is the innovative redesign of city streets to expand and improve the bike network, with emphasis on improving connectivity between neighborhoods, increasing access to safe bicycle infrastructure across the city, and creating a more equitable transportation network that serves all New Yorkers.
  
  
The Cycling & Micromobility unit seeks to hire a Program Coordinator to support the launch and implementation of the Secure Bike Program (SBP). Over the next five years, NYC DOT will install 500 secure bike parking facilities, creating thousands of safe, convenient bicycle parking spaces across New York City. This initiative will make cycling more accessible and practical by supporting ownership of a wide range of bicycles, including cargo bikes, adaptive bikes, and UL-certified e-bikes. Under the supervision of the Senior Program Manager, the Program Coordinator will play a key role in the deployment and operation of SBP facilities citywide. The candidate will identify technically viable locations for SBP installation through field investigations and site evaluations and review installation plans to ensure accuracy and compliance with project requirements. The candidate will maintain and manage accurate databases to ensure data accuracy and integrity, develop data collection protocols, assist with performance reporting, and oversee pre-installation notifications and post-installation inspections and reporting. The candidate will create maps using ArcGIS and produce presentations and outreach materials using Adobe Creative Suite and Microsoft PowerPoint for senior leadership, stakeholders, and the public. The candidate will liaise with internal divisions, sister agencies, and community stakeholders to facilitate installations and activations. The candidate will support public education and engagement efforts related to program goals and facility types, including presentations to community members and promotion at outreach events. The candidate will also respond to inquiries and support communication efforts related to SBP. The candidate will perform additional planning, analysis, and operational tasks related to the implementation and ongoing management of the Secure Bike Program, as needed.
  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented, proactive, and collaborative professional with strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. The candidate should be comfortable working both independently and as part of a team and demonstrate a willingness to conduct fieldwork year-round while traveling by bicycle, on foot, or via public transit.
  
  
The Department of Transportation’s (DOT) mission is to provide for the safe, efficient, and environmentally responsible movement of people and goods in the City of New York and to maintain and enhance the transportation infrastructure crucial to the economic vitality and quality of life of our primary customers, City residents. DOT is an equal opportunity employer, committed to recruiting and maintaining a diverse workforce in an open and inclusive environment.
